cells.proposed: Orbit (Boston Dynamics): orchestration and intelligence software for Boston Dynamics robots (Spot and Stretch; Atlas announced for later): mission editing and scheduling, remote operation, inspections with alerts and a vision-language model, site history from Spot's 360-degree images, dashboards, APIs and webhooks; cloud, on-site or virtual machine. Boston Dynamics says an MCP layer lets AI agents start Spot missions (blog, 2026-11).
